# Al-Islah Institute

> Islamic welfare foundation and online Quran academy — verified support for needy families, and one-to-one online classes in Quran, Tafseer, Hadith, Hifz and Islamic studies with qualified male and female teachers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Mission, services, and impact of Al-Islah Institute.
- [About](/about): Our values, mission, and Islamic principles behind the foundation.
- [Welfare Services](/welfare): Ration, marriage, mosque, education and emergency support for verified families.
- [Courses](/courses): Online Quran, Tafseer, Hadith, Hifz, Muallima and Islamic Studies courses.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Country-based fees for online Quran classes with free trial.
- [Verification](/verification): The five-step process we follow before delivering any support.
- [Donation](/donation): Sponsor a student, ration, marriage, mosque or general donation.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos from our education and welfare work.
